description: Masood Textile Mills Limited is a vertically integrated knitwear manufacturer based in Faisalabad, with in-house yarn, knitting, fabric dyeing and processing, apparel manufacturing and laundry facilities. It produces knitted apparel from basic to highly fashioned garments for international customers, and organises its mills into five strategic business units.
headOffice: 17/1, New Civil Lines, Bilal Road, Faisalabad, Pakistan
